prompt_transform.guidance: Video prompts must specify what changes over time: subject motion, environmental motion, camera motion, timing, direction, and speed.
prompt_transform.template: Motion/Temporal Progression: {subject} performs {action}; motion {motion}; camera {camera}; timing stays readable.

negative_constraints: Do not write a video prompt that only describes a still image.
Do not combine multiple conflicting motion directions in one shot.
quality_checks: Subject motion and camera motion do not conflict.

source_refs.label: Runway Academy Prompting Guide
source_refs.note: Video prompts need visual and motion descriptions.

source_refs.label: Runway Gen-3 prompting guide
source_refs.note: Prompt examples explicitly name camera movement.

prompt_transform.guidance: When a source image or keyframe exists, focus text on motion, camera work, and temporal progression rather than restating the image contents.
prompt_transform.template: Motion/Temporal Progression: preserve source composition; animate motion {motion} and camera {camera}.

negative_constraints: Do not redescribe or redesign the uploaded/source image unless requested.
Do not introduce a new subject that conflicts with source imagery.
quality_checks: Prompt describes what should happen after the frame.

source_refs.label: Runway Academy Prompting Guide
source_refs.note: Image-to-video prompts should focus on motion, camera work, and temporal progression.

prompt_transform.guidance: Match motion intensity to emotion and style; restrained beats need subtle motion and clean timing.
prompt_transform.template: Motion/Temporal Progression: pacing supports {emotion}; motion remains consistent with {style}.

negative_constraints: Do not use rapid shake or whip movement for a quiet beat unless the contrast is deliberate.
Do not accelerate motion so much that subject action becomes unreadable.
quality_checks: Timing remains suitable for short-video readability.

source_refs.label: Runway Academy Prompting Guide
source_refs.note: Motion style, timing, direction, and speed are core video prompt components.

prompt_transform.guidance: Use subtle environmental motion to make the scene alive without distracting from the subject.
prompt_transform.template: Motion/Temporal Progression: environmental motion in {scene} stays secondary to the main beat.

negative_constraints: Do not let background effects overpower the subject.
Do not add weather, particles, or crowds unless useful.
quality_checks: The subject remains the main focus.

source_refs.label: Runway Academy Prompting Guide
source_refs.note: Environmental motion is one of the motion components.
